mission: Re-derive the factual accuracy of the site's most load-bearing YMYL claims. Extract the 3-5 most consequential numeric/factual claims from each of 8 assigned pages, then verify each against the page's own cited sources (or authoritative equivalents) using web tools. Per claim: CONFIRMED / REFUTED / UNVERIFIED + source URL + retrieved date.
parent_objective: SQ-068 full content/SEO/quality audit of utilityexplained.com
context: Read .squad/SQ-068/audit-criteria.md FIRST (binding rubric). This is a money-adjacent site (rates, bills, assistance programs) — accuracy failures here are trust-critical. Your 8 pages (all in content/blog/): utility-assistance-programs-liheap.md, can-utility-shut-off-service.md, 2026-utility-cost-index-by-state.md, average-utility-bills-by-state-2026.md, 48-heat-pump-vs-gas-furnace-savings.md, 46-what-time-is-electricity-cheapest.md, net-metering-explained.md, drought-surcharge-on-water-bill-explained.md. Method: read the page, pull its front-matter sources list, fetch the cited source (web_fetch) and compare the specific claim; if a cited link is DEAD or redirects, that is itself a finding (broken citation). If the page cites no source for a load-bearing number, verdict UNVERIFIED + flag 'unsupported'. Prioritize: LIHEAP benefit amounts, shut-off protection rules, EIA/state rate figures, heat-pump efficiency/savings percentages, TOU peak windows.
known_facts: Today is 2026-08-29 — a 2025 figure presented as current is REFUTED-adjacent (flag as outdated-current-claim)
A prior factcheck exists (SEO-CONTENT-AUDIT-FACTCHECK-2026-08-29.md + TIER2 file) — you may read for orientation; your verdicts must be freshly derived from fetched sources
Cite every URL you fetched + retrieval date (2026-08-29)
constraints: Read-only on repo; web tools ONLY for fetching cited/authoritative sources
No verdict without a fetched source or an explicit unsupported-flag
success_criteria: 24-40 claim verdicts (CONFIRMED/REFUTED/UNVERIFIED), each with: page + claim quote + checked URL + retrieved date
Dead/expired citation list (link status per fetched source)
Summary: accuracy rate, worst findings, whether any REFUTED claim needs same-day correction
